sageh.source: Yearly Goals.xlsx 'Sage GL History' tab — read fresh every run per SKILL.md §2c; baked payload is only the fallback (never splice null). R35: optional disc ($, GL-negative) + gross series from the Discount % column. R37: optional nrMgn / cbMgn / wtyMgn series — the Non-Rev / Callback / Warranty Margin columns, dollars exactly as the Summary card's Margin row (negative = loss; blank → 0; all three to BOTH trades or to neither). The R36 nrEro/cbEro/wtyEro keys are RETIRED — no Excel column ever carried them. The Trends margin section hides when a payload lacks the keys

june_parity.caveat: R38: membership revenue moves revenue/GM whenever goals.json carries mem keys — June parity holds ONLY when the goals payload has no mem block. R41 changed FLAG CLASSIFICATION only. R42 adds assumed install pay only on Install-bucket jobs ≤14 days old at the data-snapshot moment — mature-month rebuilds byte-identical (verified). R43 paces the three fixed monthly $ (Holiday Pay / PTO / onboarding × $4,000) by the engine's elapsedFrac — on a CLOSED month elapsedFrac=1, paced = full monthly, and the June A/B vs R42 is byte-identical (RAW modulo builtAt; 12/12 rendered panes across 4 tabs × 3 scopes; every pre-existing summary key; verified 2026-08-05 with the baseline fixed values loaded). A YOUNG window legitimately moves: Direct Labor carries only the elapsed share of the fixed $ (MTD = monthly × elapsedFrac), so mid-month GM/CP read higher — and more honest — than R42, and the Pace view carries exactly the full monthly fixed $ instead of inflating it by ÷ elapsedFrac. That is the point of R43, not drift. R44 is DISPLAY-ONLY (full-screen job card + project rollup, built on row click from the engine's own per-job records) — it cannot move any number: June A/B vs R43 verified 12/12 rendered panes byte-identical, RAW byte-identical (modulo builtAt), every summary key identical.

release_rule: A template revision is NOT released until, in the SAME session: (1) this template.html + manifest are re-frozen in the repo, (2) the skill bundle is re-saved with the matching pp_template.html and SKILL.md, (3) the nightly task prompt carries no stale revision facts. Nightly: if the skill folder SKILL.md states a HIGHER revision than this manifest, that is a broken release — STOP and report; never silently publish the older engine.
notes: R44 (2026-08-06, per Stephen): FULL-SCREEN JOB CARD + PROJECT ROLLUP - 'on the jobs tab, when you expand a job, the labor breakdown is condensed so you cant see the numbers... that table only expands partially, it should fill the screen... since it has the job# and project# it can connect jobs to projects... we need to know what the total revenue, discount, labor %, purchase%, Gross margin %, Gross Profit $ is for all the jobs on the project combined.' Three fixes, all display-only. (1) The old inline <tr class=det> expansion rendered INSIDE table.jobs, so nested cells inherited white-space:nowrap and the long labor-build labels overlapped/clipped the numbers (the Techs line clipped mid-name at 1600px). (2) It sat inside the gridwrap 70vh scroll box, so it only ever opened partially. Clicking a job now opens a fixed full-screen overlay card (.jdov, body-level, outside the table): waterfall / labor build (assumed-vs-actual COM and install plan-vs-posted inline on wrapped readable lines + a Direct Labor total row) / commission derivation, close via X, Esc or backdrop click. (3) When the job carries a Project #, the card adds the Project rollup: every sibling job on that project in the loaded month (revenue-desc rows: rev, counting disc, labor $ %, purchases $ %, GM % $, current job highlighted, member rows click through to their own card) plus six combined tiles - Total revenue, Discounts (+ project disc % of book -> comm rate off the engine's own project tier), Labor %, Purchases %, GM % (gm-banded pill), GP $ - because one compliant project sale is often split across several jobs/crews (dig/drywall/pipe/backfill) and one job can margin poorly while the PROJECT as sold is healthy. Aggregation is pure display arithmetic over the engine's per-job records (same convention as the grid TOTAL row); the engine's project grouping/tier math (computeAll 'projects' map) is UNTOUCHED. Notes state the month-window caveat, the subs/permits-in-GM reconciliation and benign-credit exclusion. buildSaveHtml splices PAGE0 so an open card never serializes into a saved copy. Verified 2026-08-06 (jsdom, June exports, frozen build.js, goals=skip): gates 6/6 both engines, 3,902 jobs / $6,087,636 / GM 55.3% exact, RAW byte-identical (builtAt normalized), 12/12 rendered panes (Summary+recon/P&L/Jobs/Trends x Branch/HVAC/Plumb) byte-identical, every summary key identical; 39/39 A/B+smoke checks green incl. combined stats reconciling to independent sums to the cent on a live 5-job project (P627979490: $25,333 rev / $1,333 disc / 24.8% labor / 11.3% purch / 63.5% GM / $16,095 GP), member click-through, Esc/X/backdrop close, solo-project note, no-project card without the section, save round-trip carrying R44 code with no live overlay markup; Chromium screenshots confirm the old clipping and the new card. June data carries 540 multi-job projects. Whole-file diff vs R43 = 10 intended hunks (overlay+pjsec CSS, mobile CSS, header/footer stamps, footer changelog, toggleDetail->showDetail/pjRollup, Instructions section 9). build.js and close.js run VERBATIM.

mem.source: Yearly Goals.xlsx 'Margin Variables' tab — 'Other Revenue' block (Membership row: Revenue $ + Purchases $, branch monthly totals)
mem.split: 94% HVAC / 6% Plumbing, applied at ingest into PP_GOALS[trade].mem={rev,cost}
mem.behavior: MTD = monthly x calendar elapsedFrac; pace carries the full monthly figure exactly; cost lands in Purchases; all margins/% re-base to TOTAL revenue; mem absent/invalid → renders exactly R37

r39.caps: service-side 480 min/job, install 720 min/job; CB/WT worked entirely by an install crew inherit the install cap
r39.time_source: Job Costing 'Start of Working Time' / 'End of Working Time' x crew count from 'Assigned Technicians'; bucket median backfills the ~2% of jobs with no usable stamps
r39.rate: scope GP (and CP) split between service and install by share of job-attributed margin, divided by that side's man-minutes; lost minutes priced by the side of the tech who logged them
r39.caveat: opportunity cost at current productivity - not recoverable cash

r40.attribution: by trade, never by service manager - SMs help sell the job and do not review
r40.token_scope: fine-grained Contents read+write on the private repo ONLY - verified: write to the public pages repo returns 403
r40.aging_caveats: capped=true ages are floors (rendered >=Nd); cost-maturity inflates 0-2d flags; approval does NOT clear a flag in the data, so age alone cannot separate 'never looked at' from 'reviewed and accepted'
r40.gm_gate: ?gm=1 latches pp_gm in that browser - a visibility choice, NOT a security boundary

r41.mem_classification: job.memOver = comOver AND memRev>0 AND (actualCOM-assumedCOM) <= 12% x memRev + $1; memRev = positive invoice items matching /sadie|member/ (name or code), classification only — the pay base still excludes exactly the sadie items; memRev falls back to sadieRev when RAW predates R41
r41.no_pay: job.noPay = rev>=1000 AND zero COM/COMUT/BON/hourly — info field + dashed chip, never a flag (R42: young install jobs listed under NO-PAY already carry the assumed book plan in margin)
r41.ledger_rebase: first R41 nightly: flagged count drops (June rebase 293→171; Aug 1–3 rebase 48→7) because membership-only comm-overs and NO-PAY leave the flag set — ledger entries for those jobs stop updating (last_seen freezes); intended re-baseline, not data loss
r41.raw_compat: RAW.disc.byJob[*].memRev is the one new serialized key; R40-era saved copies classify via the sadieRev fallback — only a non-sadie membership wording (none observed in June) would be missed until the file is re-parsed

r42.rule: Install-bucket job, rev>0, age ≤14d (vs mat.asOf, End-of-Working-Time fallback Start; no usable stamp → no assumption) → instAssumed = HVAC flat-rate book by job type / Plumb 8% of job revenue; instTop = instAssumed>0 ? max(0, instAssumed − actual COMUT) : 0; labor += instTop; day 15+ → actuals only
r42.accrual_netting: n = min(pendPay, instTop) per young job; pendPay −= n; acc −= n; accrMat = accr − accrPay invariant — no double count with the Cost-Maturity pay component; the Yearly Goals Cost Maturity block needs NO change
r42.provenance: rates = median crew flat-rate pay per job type, Q2-2026 payfiles (Apr/May/Jun medians identical; 86–100% of jobs of these types carry the pay); Plumb 8% exact on 533/576 Q2 install jobs; excluded types (Parts 37% paid, Drywall, QCI) pay too irregularly to assume — re-measure INSTDEF when the install pay plan changes and cut a revision
r42.raw_compat: no new RAW keys — pre-R42 saved copies and reused nightly payloads compute R42 rules on reopen; their builtAt anchors the ages, so an old file keeps its as-built assumption

r43.rule: holiday = holidayM × elapsedFrac; pto = ptoM × elapsedFrac; onboardPay = onboardN × 4000 × elapsedFrac — inside Direct Labor, per scope; elapsedFrac = the engine's R29 elapsed-day fraction (through yesterday, capped by the window)
r43.pace_identity: Pace = MTD ÷ elapsedFrac, so the paced P&L carries exactly the full monthly fixed $ — pre-R43 pace carried fixed ÷ elapsedFrac (inflated)
r43.display: P&L rows + Reconciliation annotate 'NN% elapsed of $X/mo' when elapsedFrac<1; plain labels on closed months (byte-identical to R42); Variables labels now read '$/mo — paced to elapsed days'
r43.untouched: job-level math, flags (verified identical sets), accrual + accrual netting, instTop, Handoff, RAW format, review machinery
r43.raw_compat: no new RAW keys — pre-R43 saved copies pace on reopen via their embedded VARS monthly values (same reopen semantics as overhead pro-ration)

r44.ux: row click opens a fixed full-screen overlay card (.jdov) OUTSIDE table.jobs - kills the inherited white-space:nowrap overlap AND the 70vh partial-expand; close via X / Esc / backdrop; mobile media block makes the pane 100vw/100vh
r44.project_rollup: shown when job.proj is set: members = S.result.jobs filtered on proj (both trades, revenue-desc); combined tiles Total revenue / Discounts (+project discPct of book -> comm rate from the engine's own tier) / Labor % / Purchases % / GM % / GP $; per-member rows rev, counting, labor $ %, pur $ %, GM % $ + PROJECT TOTAL row; solo-project note when members==1; caveat: loaded data month only
r44.aggregation: pure display sums of engine per-job fields (rev/counting/benign/labor/pur/sub+permit/gm) - identical convention to the Jobs grid TOTAL row; no math re-implemented, computeAll untouched
r44.labor_build: assumed-vs-actual COM and install plan-vs-posted now inline on the COM/COMUT rows (wrapped, readable); new Direct labor total row ($ + % of revenue)
r44.untouched: parsers, computeAll, buckets, flags, accrual + netting, Handoff, Trends, review machinery, renderJobs (Jobs pane byte-identical) - RAW format unchanged, no new serialized keys
r44.raw_compat: pre-R44 saved copies reopen unchanged (their embedded engine renders the old inline row); files saved FROM R44 carry the card + rollup
